common: Create one simple natural photographic landscape menu-card image, 3:2 framing. Use the attached fully clothed portrait as the identity reference: exactly one adult Paige, same rounded face, soft broad jaw, brown eyes, teal-blue tousled short pixie hair, small nose ring. Preserve her fuller curvy build and full arms and shoulders; do not slim her. Face and body identity are most important; botanical arm tattoos are secondary. Everyday fully clothed outfit suited to the scene. Waist-up or thigh-up composition, face prominent near centre and fully inside frame, readable when cropped to 16:10. Candid eye-level view as if meeting her. Believable expression, restrained background and natural light. Single image, no collage, panels, labels, logos or text.
